Qoder CLI

Usage: qodercli [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]

  --list-models
  --model <native-id>
  --reasoning-effort <value>
  --thinking auto|adaptive|enabled|disabled
  --print
  --output-format stream-json
  --permission-mode default|accept_edits|bypass_permissions|dont_ask|auto
  --tools <tools>
  --resume <id>
  login
